WITH product_units AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS SIGNED)), 0) AS units
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY product_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    units,
    units / NULLIF(SUM(units) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM product_units
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    units,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share
  FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(units) AS combined_units,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > overall_average_share

assumptions.assumption: Uses MySQL syntax; product quantities are whole-number strings or NULL, and their total is positive so shares are defined.
